vocalizedHe:
כִּימֵי צֵאתְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם.
אַרְאֶנּוּ נִפְלָאוֹת:
אוֹדְךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי עָשִׂיתָ.
וַאֲקַוֶּה שִׁמְךָ כִּי טוֹב נֶגֶל חֲסִידֶךָ
translation:
As in the days when you came out of the land of Egypt,
we will see your wonders:
I will praise you forever for what you have done.
And I will wait for Your name, for it is good; Your faithful ones will see Your salvation.
